import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Assuming the data is already loaded into a DataFrame called df
df['Flight Number'] = df['flight'].str.extract(r'(?P<FlightNumber>\d{6})')  # Extract flight number

df['Scheduled Departure Time'] = df['Departure City']  # Add a new column for scheduled departure time

# Convert flight number to datetime object and set as actual departure time
df['Actual Departure Time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Flight Number'], format='%Y%m%d')

# Filter rows where the actual departure time is earlier than scheduled departure time
early_departures = df[(df['Actual Departure Time'] < df['Scheduled Departure Time'])].reset_index(drop=True)
return value
